Projects.title: Selected Work
Projects.p1_summary: Secure organizational platform for pharmaceutical students, built on Supabase with Vercel CI, advanced RLS, and permission rules.
Projects.p1_desc:
Official organizational platform for pharmacy students (Kemafar), built on **Supabase** with continuous deployment via **Vercel**.

- Member authentication & role management
- Automated CI/CD pipeline for safe, consistent releases

The focus of this project was building a secure, reliable data foundation for the organization's operational needs.
Projects.p2_summary: Performance-first typing test with real-time analytics and an uncluttered UI.

Built to prove interactive apps can stay lightweight and fast.
Projects.p3_summary: Composable seat-selection UI component for logistics apps, published as an NPM package.

**Highlights:**

- Documented and ready to use across projects

This project emphasizes reusability and developer experience as a public library.
Projects.p4_summary: SaaS-ready starter with secure auth, RLS, and real-time DB subscriptions.

**What's included:**

Designed so teams can focus on business features instead of boilerplate.

**Includes:**

A solid foundation for modern Laravel apps with a comfortable DX.

A mature starting point for high-performance backend services.

Keeps digital spaces healthy through intelligent detection.
Projects.p9_summary: A web platform for a local Water Gel Blaster tournament, with a live dashboard for zone standings and operations.

A web platform for a local Water Gel Blaster tournament.

**Highlights:**
- A live dashboard with real-time updates for zone standings and operations feeds

- A dark-mode UI with smooth animations

Built to give organizers and participants a clear, up-to-date view of the event.
Projects.p10_summary: A full-scale ERP for bakery operations — production, inventory, sales, and accounting in one platform with cross-module data integrity.
Projects.p10_desc:
A full-scale ERP system I built to run an entire bakery business on a single platform. It unifies four modules that usually live apart — **production, inventory, sales, and accounting** — while enforcing cross-module data integrity: when the kitchen completes a batch, raw-material stock is deducted automatically, finished goods land in the outlet display, and the accounting journal is posted consistently.

Built on **Laravel 12 + Inertia + React (TypeScript)**, with a real-time Kitchen Display System, granular role-based access control, and backed by **1,100+ automated tests**.
Projects.p10_f1_d: Multi-level recipes (BOM), automatic COGS calculation, real-time Kitchen Display System over websockets.
Projects.p10_f2_d: Per-outlet raw-material & finished-goods stock, inter-outlet transfers, periodic stock opname.
Projects.p10_f3_d: Cashier and member loyalty program with 9,000+ registered members.
Projects.p10_f4_d: Automatic journaling, Chart of Accounts, balance sheet & P&L reports.
Projects.p10_f5_d: Employee records, shift scheduling, payroll with allowances & overtime.
Projects.p10_f6_d: Granular RBAC (Spatie Permission) and activity audit trail.

Architecture.title: How I build
Architecture.description: I design systems to be clear, dependable, and easy to grow — planned up front, then built to hold up in production.
Architecture.f1_desc: Convert business rules into clear class, sequence, and flow diagrams for engineering alignment.
Architecture.f2_desc: Build systems in clean, independent parts, so each piece is easy to change and test without breaking the rest.
Architecture.f3_desc: Design how data is stored and indexed so the app stays fast and reliable as it grows.
Architecture.f4_desc: Connect services with secure sign-in and clear documentation, so everything works together safely.
